title: Broadcom earnings call 2026-05-17

architecture_signals.custom_silicon_named: Ironwood TPU (Google), MTIA (Meta), Anthropic TPU, OpenAI XPU
architecture_signals.architecture_freetext: Broadcom shipping custom XPUs for six customers; customers developing specialized training vs inference chips; Direct Attach Copper networking through 400G SerDes preferred over CPO; Ethernet scale-out standard; scale-up Ethernet emerging.

key_quotes: We have fully secured capacity of these components for 2026 through 2028.
We have line of sight to achieve AI revenue from chips in excess of $100 billion in 2027.
Custom accelerators across all our five customers progressing very well.
